description_en: Update an outbound call job by instance ID and job ID
description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID更新外呼任务
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs update-ai-outbound-task --instance-id agent_000 --task-id 123 --name 'xxxx外呼' --description '房产销售' --outbound-nums 15000000000 --num-repeated 1 --handler-id 123 --execution-time '{"TUESDAY":[{"start":"06:00","end":"06:05"}],"MONDAY":[{"start":"09:00","end":"18:00"},{"start":"20:30","end":"21:45"},{"start":"22:30","end":"22:50"}],"WEDNESDAY":[{"start":"09:00","end":"18:00"}],"THURSDAY":[{"start":"09:00","end":"18:00"}],"FRIDAY":[{"start":"09:00","end":"18:00"}],"SATURDAY":[{"start":"09:00","end":"18:00"}],"SUNDAY":[{"start":"17:00","end":"23:45"}]}' --concurrent-rate 10 --recall-rule Count=2 Interval=5 --forecast-call-rate 1.2 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAiOutboundTask

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The job ID.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html API and check the Data field in the response, or invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html API and check the TaskId field in the response
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312260.html接口，查看返回参数中的**Data**，或者调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2718026.html接口，查看返回参数中的**TaskId**
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The job description. It can contain 0 to 100 characters
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The policy for handling duplicate callee numbers.
0: Remove duplicates within the job.
1: Do not remove duplicates within the job
parameters.help_zh:
被叫号码重复策略。
0：任务内去重。
1：任务内不去重
parameters.name: num_repeated

parameters.help_en: The skill group ID (for predictive outbound calls) or IVR ID (for automated outbound calls)
parameters.help_zh: 技能组ID（预测式外呼）或者IVR ID（自动外呼）
parameters.name: handler_id

parameters.help_en:
The job execution time.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
任务执行时间。

结束时间（end）需晚于开始时间（start）
parameters.name: execution_time

parameters.help_en: The concurrent rate for automated outbound calls
parameters.name: concurrent_rate

fields.help_en: Number of retries after a failed call. Valid values: 1 to 3
fields.help_zh: 失败重呼次数。取值范围：1～3次
fields.name: count

fields.help_en: Time interval between retries after a failed call. Valid values: 1 to 60, unit: minutes
fields.help_zh: 失败重呼间隔时间。取值范围：1～60，单位：分钟
fields.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
Failed-call retry policy.

If empty, no retry is performed when an outbound call fails
parameters.help_zh:
失败重呼策略。

为空则外呼失败时不重呼
parameters.name: recall_rule

parameters.help_en: Fixed dialing ratio for predictive outbound calls. Valid values: ≥1
parameters.help_zh: 预测式外呼固定外呼比例。取值范围：≥1
parameters.name: forecast_call_rate
